recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的髓腔被交織、呈漩渦狀的梭形纖維母細胞與膠原取代，幾乎看不到脂肪與正常造血，符合真性紅血球增多症後骨髓纖維化（post-PV myelofibrosis）。
features: Marrow space replaced by a hypocellular-to-moderately cellular proliferation of bland spindle cells in a collagenous stroma
Streaming and whorled fascicular arrangement of fibroblasts
Scattered dilated small vessels within the fibrotic stroma
Residual hematopoietic cells sparse and difficult to identify at this magnification; adipocytes essentially absent
Fragmented bony trabeculae without obvious osteosclerosis in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy sections show marrow spaces between bony trabeculae effaced by a proliferation of bland spindle-shaped fibroblasts arranged in streaming and whorled bundles within a collagenous stroma. Small dilated vessels are present, and fat is essentially absent. Residual hematopoietic elements are sparse in this field and are better assessed at higher power or with immunostains. Reticulin and trichrome stains are required to grade fibrosis. In a patient with a history of polycythemia vera, findings are consistent with post-polycythemic myelofibrosis.

ddx.vs: Morphology is essentially identical; separation relies on a documented prior PV phase (JAK2-mutated erythrocytosis) rather than histology.
Also histologically indistinguishable and defined by a prior ET history with normal hemoglobin rather than PV.
Fibrosis contains cohesive epithelial clusters that are keratin-positive, unlike the bland spindle fibroblasts here.

ddx.dx: Hairy cell leukemia or systemic mastocytosis with fibrosis
ddx.vs: These contain an infiltrate of CD20/annexin A1-positive hairy cells or CD117/tryptase-positive spindle mast cells, detectable by immunohistochemistry.
